notes: No object marker stands anywhere in the verse, so the appositional *even* answers to no morpheme and is `added` (rule 16).
`לְבֵית אֲבֹתֵיהֶם` is split as rule 31 directs — *houses* to `בַּיִת`, *fathers* to `אָב` — while the later `הָאָבוֹת`, written without `בַּיִת`, takes the supplied head noun into its own unit.
`לִפְקוּדֵיהֶם` is anarthrous, so rule 46 supplies the English noun phrase to the participle and the suffix keeps only its *of them* (rule 19).
